name: Sandbox Access
description: Show what this workspace's run-code can reach beyond PyPI, or turn it on or off: the web, and a model to ask (with a daily token budget). Off by default. Turning either on, or raising the budget, asks the user to approve it in the chat, and works only in AnythingLLM's own chat; never do it unless the user asked. A run with web access can't see other workspaces' /shared folders.
author: anything

examples.prompt: Can my scripts fetch web pages?
Let the sandbox reach the web so the script can download today's prices
Let my scripts summarize with an AI model

web.description: "on" or "off"; leave out to keep it as it is.

models.description: "on" or "off": whether runs can ask a model; leave out to keep it as it is.

daily_tokens.description: The model budget, tokens a day (default 200000); leave out to keep it.

apply.description: true to make the change (the user is asked to approve turning on or raising); without it, only show what would change.
